completion:
Then examine the building survey facility condition summaries and floor plans.
3. Each condition documented on the condition summaries should be recorded by taking a photo of the issue and plotting the location on a floor plan. Include photos or indications of other aspects of the management or design that contribute to the accessibility issues (or lack thereof).
4. All records, including photos, should be organized so as to allow for a valid and repeatable review.

## Guidance for interpreting ADAAG Section 4.2 for documentation

An inspection document only says whether or not a building meets the applicable standards. It does not provide the evidence, photos, or evidence of the actual locations where failures of the design actually occurred. The evidence and actual location pictures will help us determine which compliance issues should be addressed on certain projects and which issues can be deferred for future projects.
